notes.title: v0.4.3.0 Add beach shop missions
notes.content:
Add simulate food delivery missions (Lily), complete the challenges and receive praise. 
    Subsequent versions of the game will gradually be modified to focus on the main mission, and complete various challenges to unlock H animation. Completing a mission perfectly will reward you with a training item. 
    Modify the EA test target, reduce the number of purely H animations, and add a training module that players can actively participate in (must get props in from completing missions)
    Lighten the shadow density of darker areas on the character.

notes.title: v0.4.2.0 Adjust the lighting effect as a whole
notes.content:
Reduce the overall brightness of the scene to fix the overexposure problem. 
    Go through the stone cave on the other side of the beach, and you will arrive at the beach shop. Currently, only scenes have been added. Specific gameplay will be added in subsequent versions.
